versions.description: Original enactment. Fee schedule with specific dollar amounts, three subsections: (a) fee schedule with 11 items, (b) applicability to US Government, (c) fee crediting and refunds.
Changed fee crediting in subsec. (c) from 'in the manner directed by the Secretary of the Treasury' to 'to the appropriation for necessary expenses of the Copyright Office'.
Changed (a)(1) and (a)(2) wording from 'for the registration of' to 'on filing each application for registration of', added 'if registration is made'. Struck refund-deduction provision from (c).
Rewrote (a) with higher fees ($20/$12/$4 etc.) and 10 items instead of 11. Added new subsec. (b) for CPI-based fee adjustments. Redesignated former (b) and (c) as (c) and (d).
Changed (a)(2) renewal fee from $12 to $20 and struck 'in its first term' after 'copyright'.
Amended (b) generally to replace CPI formula with study-based fee increase mechanism. Amended (d) generally to add provisions for deposit account investments.

Amended (a) generally, removing specific dollar amounts and adding language about Register fixing fees for other services. Amended (b) introductory provisions to replace 'increase' with 'adjust' and changed year references.
Added paragraphs (10) and (11) to (a) for satellite/cable statements of account, and added concluding provisions about fees for those paragraphs.
added subsec. (e) for fee waivers for covered competitions (ARTS Act).
Current text including 2022 amendment (PL 117-201) adding subsec. (e) on fee waivers for covered competitions.
